purpose: Pins the llama.cpp reference used to check the Bubo Gemma 4 vision encoder (multislot 2026-10-17). Reproduce with tools/gemma4/llama_vision.cpp, gemma4_vision_probe --file ... --gpu --no-reference --dump-dir, and tools/gemma4/compare_embeddings.py.

llama_cpp.runtime: llama.cpp b11316, stock Windows HIP build
llama_cpp.encoder_run: CPU backend (use_gpu=false), flash attention on, 6 threads; text model loaded vocab-only
llama_cpp.vision_activation: gelu_quick: the mmproj GGUF lacks clip.use_gelu, so mtmd falls back to GELU-quick. The model's own vision config says gelu_pytorch_tanh, which Bubo uses.

preprocessing.bubo: native size: sides rounded to multiples of 48, 70..1120 soft tokens like llama.cpp; Pillow-exact bicubic resize straight to that size (no padding), as the Hugging Face Gemma 4 processor does
preprocessing.llama_cpp: same target sizes, but it resizes to fit inside the target keeping the aspect ratio (ceil) and pads black (PAD_CEIL default). Identical for square images and for images whose size is already a multiple of 48; otherwise the pixels differ (640x488 -> bubo 624x480 stretched, llama 624x476 plus 2 black rows top and bottom).
preprocessing.comparison: llama_vision --rgb feeds llama.cpp the exact pixels Bubo prepares (prep/<name>.rgb) so only the encoder differs

small640.file: small640.png (PNG copy of llama.cpp tools/mtmd/test-1.jpeg, sha256 2dff664c0c8aaea18aff8cbe7e868845b775e90cdd7a0bac98df709b131deaa3)

cat3840.file: cat3840.png (PNG copy of Wikimedia Commons Cat_poster_1.jpg, sha256 1b7ccddb3135a890cd4db216431f9dafed33eaef67336ee8987b5ede63a0e41e)

bubo_gpu_encoder_vs_llama_cpu.note: rel RMS = sqrt(sum((bubo-llama)^2)/sum(llama^2)); layer 0 agrees to 3e-4..5e-3, the final embedding to 2.9 % (cb96), 16.3 % (small640), 7.8 % (cat3840)

noise_floor.note: the same pixels through llama.cpp's own CPU and GPU backends differ by 1.4 % (cb96) and 11.6 % (small640) in the final embedding; quick-GELU in Bubo's scalar reference brings cb96 to 0.58 % and small640 to 7.3 % against llama CPU, with the first 14 layers within 8e-4
noise_floor.bubo_gpu_encoder_equals_its_scalar_refer: the GPU encoder and the scalar fp32 reference agree to 1.5e-3..1.8e-3, and each differs from llama.cpp CPU by the same amount (cb96 2.9 %, small640 16.5 % with tanh-GELU), so the gap to llama.cpp is not a GPU-encoder bug

findings.gate: reference equality (about 1.5e-3), layers 0-13 below 1e-3 against llama.cpp once the activation matches, and behaviour; final-embedding rel RMS is not a usable gate
findings.preprocessing_decision: keep stretching like the Hugging Face Gemma 4 processor; do not mimic llama.cpp's black padding
findings.small640_description: the page has a large black-and-white lunar photograph in the lower centre; Bubo describes it, llama.cpp b11316 says there are no photographs (checked by eye)
